name: Pekah
bio: Pekah son of Remaliah, a captain under King Pekahiah of Israel, conspired against him with Argob, Arieh, and fifty Gileadite men, struck him down in the royal palace at Samaria, and seized the throne, reigning twenty years and doing evil in the LORD's eyes like Jeroboam before him (2 Kings 15:25-28). In his reign, Tiglath-Pileser, king of Assyria, invaded and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, Galilee, and all the land of Naphtali, deporting the people to Assyria (2 Kings 15:29). Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah, struck him down, and killed him, taking the throne for himself (2 Kings 15:30). Pekah also joined Rezin, king of Syria, in moving against Judah (2 Kings 15:37); this joint campaign against King Ahaz of Judah is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
